title: Sarwar ki Azadari
body:
aaj har mulk mein sarwar ki azadari hai
<<DIVIDER>>
hind mein paak mein lebnan mein shabbir ka gham
misr mein rom mein yunan mein shabbir ka gham
hadh hai spain mein japan mein shabbir ka gham
saari dunya ghame shabbir ki phulwari hai
aaj har mulk mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
abu dhabi pe nazar daalo kabhi qum dekho
waadi e shaam mein shabbir ka chehlum dekho
germany norway sweden mein talatum dekho
barf mein aag lagade ye wo chingari hai
aaj har mulk mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
kahin london ke azakhano mein hai majlise gham
kahin america ke sadkon pe juloose matam
ghar mein angrezon ke lehraya jari ka parcham
ba khuda amn ka paigham azadari hai
aaj har mulk mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
kuwait behrain mein muscut mein to doha mein alam
switzerland mein paris mein canada mein alam
shehre makka mein alam shehre madina mein alam
aql hairaan hai ye kaisi alamdari hai
aaj har mulk mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
libya mein hai azakhane alam sydney mein
china mein kabhi majlis kabhi nairobi mein
goonj matam ki hai tanzania mein turkey mein
yehi matam to mohamed se wafadari hai
aaj har mulk mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum ne dekha hai dehekte huwe angaron ko
unpe chalte huwe sarwar ke azadaron ko
kaash samjho kabhi zanjeer ki jhankaro ko
ghame shabbir jahan hai wahin bedaari hai
aaj har mulk mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
matame tashnalabi ab bhi hai daryaon mein
shor nauhon ka hai africa ke sehraon mein
karbala bolti hai dard ki bhashaon mein
ab bhi kaunain pe is gham ka asr taari hai
aaj har mulk mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
kahin adam ki dua hai ye aza e shabbir
kahin musa ka asa hai ye aza e shabbir
haasil e deen e khuda hai ye aza e shabbir
mohtaram kal bhi thi aur aaj bhi meyari hai
aaj har mulk mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
jiski ghaibat mein ghame sheh ka bharam rakha hai
intezar uska sare deeda e nam rakha hai
har azakhane mein ghazi ka alam rakha hai
aaj phir nusrate shabbir ki tayyari hai
aaj har mulk mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
likho nayyar ghame sarwar ki ata hai nauha
lafz hyder ke hai zehra ki dua hai nauha
teen sau tera rasoolon ki sada hai nauha
kehdo aamir ke na ye fan hai na fankari hai
aaj har mulk mein...
author: Nayyar Jalalpuri
